title: RIZZ+++ PUZZLE
description: RIZZLE redefines the classic sliding puzzle by turning live selfies into personalized challenges. Built with real-time camera integration and multiplayer support, it provides an interactive, social, and highly engaging browser gaming experience.

title: PETVEST
description: PetVest is a student-friendly financial management platform designed to help users track expenses, build saving habits, and learn basic investment concepts in a simple and engaging way. The platform features interactive animal characters to create a more fun and approachable financial learning experience for students.

title: Insighta UMKM
description: Insighta UMKM is a machine learning-powered dashboard that analyzes Indonesian marketplace reviews using sentiment analysis and topic modeling. The platform helps MSMEs identify customer satisfaction trends and key business insights through interactive visualizations.

title: Website KKN - Desa Bandar Klippa
description: Website Desa Bandar Klippa is a digital village administration platform developed to simplify public service processes for residents of Desa Bandar Klippa. The website provides fast, transparent, and accessible administrative letter services through a modern web-based system.
featured: Source code is not publicly available due to active community use and administrative privacy considerations.

title: SIGEMA
description: SIGEMA - Silica Gel Effectiveness Monitoring & Assistant IoT project integrating ESP32 and MQTT to monitor silica gel effectiveness in real time.
featured: 3rd Place Winner in Youth Scientific Writing – Technology Innovation by DISPORA Jakarta Pusat (July 2025).

title: SignaText
description: SignaText combines website development and Machine Learning to help people with disabilities communicate more easily.
featured: Capstone Project for Fullstack Web Developer Cohort @ Bank DBS | DBS Foundation (April 2025).

title: sembaGO Mart
description: SembaGO Mart is a responsive grocery marketplace website designed to simplify online shopping for daily household needs with fast delivery and cash-on-delivery support. Built with a clean and user-friendly interface, the platform focuses on accessibility, promotional visibility, and seamless customer interaction for local consumers.
featured: Client-based project developed for a local grocery business to support digital product promotion and online ordering services.

title: NYAWIT – Panen Monitoring
description: NYAWIT – Panen Monitoring is a mobile-based harvest monitoring application developed to simplify palm oil harvest data recording and visualization in real time. The app provides features for inputting harvest results, tracking production data, and analyzing harvest trends through interactive graphs to support more efficient field management.
featured: Client-based project developed for palm oil harvest monitoring and field data management purposes.
